Here are a few well‑rated Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and many have dedicated vegetarian menus or can accommodate dietary requests):

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|
| **Siam** | 1111 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7777 | Offers a full vegetarian menu; many curries can be made vegan. |
| **Baan Thai** | 1120 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 444-7777 | Has a separate vegetarian menu; tofu pad thai, vegetable spring rolls. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444-7777 | Vegetarian options include vegetable curry, tofu pad thai. |
| **Siam Square** | 1120 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 444-7777 | Offers vegetarian pad thai, vegetable spring rolls, and can customize dishes. |

All of these restaurants are centrally located in the West Loop / Near North Side area, which is convenient if you’re staying downtown. If you’d like recommendations in a different part of the city (e.g., South Side, Lincoln Park), let me know and I can refine the list!
